column1: 22736§create§kriˈeɪt§vt. 创造，创作； 产生§The economic recovery created more jobs.§经济复苏带来了更多的工作机会。
22737§mime§maɪm§v. 模拟，模仿 n. 哑剧表演；哑剧演员§The naughty boy mimed his old grandfather.§这个淘气的孩子模仿他年迈的祖父。
22738§impose§ɪmˈpəʊz§v. 把…强加于；征（税等）；处以（罚款、监禁等）§I imposed certain constraints on them to make things simple.§为了让事情变得简单，我给它们加了一些限制。
22739§likelihood§ˈlaɪklihʊd§n. 可能；可能性§The likelihood that animals living in forests will become extinct is increased when the forests are cut down.§砍伐森林会增加生活在森林中的动物灭绝的可能性。
22740§explode§ɪkˈspləʊd§v. （使）爆炸；爆发；激增§The experts have thought of a way to explode the dynamite below this building.§专家们已经想出了一种方法来引爆这幢楼下的炸药。
22741§spectacular§spekˈtækjələ(r)§adj. 壮观的；令人惊叹的 n. 壮观的场面；精彩的表演§Tyler and Vanessa are seated near floor-to-ceiling windows affording a spectacular view of the city.§泰勒和瓦尼莎坐在落地窗边，壮观市景尽收眼底。
22742§enormous§ɪˈnɔːməs§adj. 巨大的，庞大的，极大的§We grow an enormous number of bananas each year.§我们每年都大量种植香蕉。

22743§counterproductive§ˌkaʊntəprəˈdʌktɪv§adj. 产生相反效果的，适得其反的§This phenomenon can be partly attributed to the common counterproductive approach to study, but it also simply reflects the way the brain functions.§这种现象可以部分归因于普通反作用的研究方法，但它也简单地反映了大脑的活动方式。
22744§variant§ˈveəriənt§adj. 不同的 n. 变量；变体§In its most recent variant, the book consists of the reading of vocabulary and text while the class is listening to music.§在这本书的最新版中，学生可以边听音乐边阅读词汇与篇章。
22745§healing§ˈhiːlɪŋ§n. 康复，复原 adj. 有治疗作用的§Hypnosis, yoga, religious ceremonies and faith healing are all associated with successful suggestion.§催眠、瑜伽、宗教仪式和信仰疗法都与成功的暗示相关。

22746§autocratic§ˌɔːtəˈkrætɪk§adj. 独裁的，专制的§A doctor calls on the full power of autocratic suggestion by insisting that the patient take this white capsule precisely three times a day before meals.§医生坚持要求病人一日三餐前按时服用这种白色胶囊，以此呼吁要遵从医嘱的绝对权威。

22747§emulate§ˈemjuleɪt§vt. 与…竞争，赶上；仿真，模仿§While suggestopedia has gained some reputation through success in the teaching of modern languages, few teachers are able to emulate the spectacular results of Lozanov and his associates.§在现代语言教学所取得的成功中，暗示教学法已经享有一定的声誉，几乎没有教师可以取得像洛扎诺夫及其同僚们那样引人注目的成果。

22748§disastrous§dɪˈzɑːstrəs§adj. 损失惨重的，灾难性的；极坏的§The disastrous Hanshin earthquake in 1995 killed 6,400 people, toppled elevated highways, flattened office blocks and devastated the port area of Kobe.§1995年的阪神大地震极具灾难性，致使6,400人丧生，高架公路倒塌，办公大楼夷为平地，神户港口地区变成废墟。
22749§topple§ˈtɒpl§v. 倒塌，倒下；打倒，推翻§The old man toppled backwards into the river, but no one came up to give a helping hand.§老人后仰翻入河里，但没有人上前伸出援助之手。
22750§resilience§rɪˈzɪliəns§n. 弹性，弹力；复原力；适应性；乐观的性情§Scientists couldn't explain the great resilience of Japanese pagodas in the earthquake.§科学家无法解释为什么日本宝塔在地震中有强大的抗震力。
22751§collateral§kəˈlætərəl§adj. 并行的；间接的，附带的§The cost is in the collateral damage of the very methods of food production that has made the food cheaper.§某些食品生产方法降低了食物的价格，但代价是带来附带性的危害。
22752§colossal§kəˈlɒsl§adj. 巨大的，庞大的§The damage that the earthquake has caused has been colossal.§地震带来极大的破坏。

22753§tackle§ˈtækl§v. 对付，处理；向某人提起（问题或困难情况）；（足球等比赛中）抢断，抢球n. 用具，器具；滑轮（组），滑车；（足球等比赛中）抢断§The disappointing results of many conventional road transport projects in Africa led some experts to rethink the strategy by which rural transport problems were to be tackled at the beginning of 1990s.§因为非洲许多传统公路运输项目的结果令人失望，一些专家重新思考战略，希望农村交通问题能在20世纪90年代初得到解决。

22754§coordinate§kəʊˈɔːdɪneɪt§v. 调整，协调 [kəʊˈɔːdɪnət] n. 同等者，同等物 adj. 同等的，并列的§The Makete Integrated Rural Transport Project started in 1985 with financial support from the Swiss Development Corporation and was coordinated with the help of the Tanzanian government.§玛科特农村综合交通项目自1985年启动，由瑞士发展公司提供资金支持，在坦桑尼亚政府的协调下进行。
22755§cognition§kɒgˈnɪʃn§n. 感知，认知；认识力§Child studies center on theories of cognition of two-year-old children.§儿童研究集中研究两岁孩子的认知理论。
22756§supplementary§ˌsʌplɪˈmentri§adj. 增补的，补充的§The man can clearly tell you the need for supplementary measures if one wants to assist the rural poor.§那个人可以清楚地告诉你扶助农村贫民过程中配套措施的必要性。

22757§scrutiny§ˈskruːtəni§n. 详细检查，细看；监视§The world of the ant has come in for considerable scrutiny lately, and the idea that ants demonstrate sparks of cognition has not been rejected by those involved in these investigations.§近期有大量针对蚂蚁王国的详细研究，参与研究的人员并未否定那种认为蚂蚁能表现出认知迹象的想法。
22758§repel§rɪˈpel§vt. 击退，驱逐；抵制，拒绝；使反感，使厌恶§Ants store food, repel attackers and use chemical signals to contact one another in case of attack.§蚂蚁储存食物，击退进攻者，通过化学信号联系同伴以防御攻击。
22759§domesticate§dəˈmestɪkeɪt§vt. 驯养，教化；使喜爱家居生活§It seems that ants are continually domesticating new species.§蚂蚁似乎在不断地驯化新品种。

22760§exhaustive§ɪɡˈzɔːstɪv§adj. 全面的，彻底的，详尽的§During the course of this exhaustive study, Reznikova has grown so attached to her laboratory ants that she feels she knows them as individuals even without the paint spots used to mark them.§经过详尽的学习，热兹尼科娃深深爱上了她实验室里的蚂蚁，她觉得自己甚至不用通过油漆点标记也可以辨认出每一只蚂蚁。

22761§calibrate§ˈkælɪbreɪt§vt. 标定，划分；校准刻度§People can establish their genetic “distance”, which itself can be calibrated to give an indication of the length of time since these populations last interbred.§人们能够确定遗传距离，这一距离的划定将表明族群自上一次杂交迄今的时间长度。
22762§descend§dɪˈsend§v. 下来，下降；降临；遗传§As would have been predicted by Robert Williams's work, all three groups appear to be descended from the same ancestral population.§正如罗伯特·威廉斯的文章所预测的，三组人都是同一祖先的后裔。
22763§frontier§ˈfrʌntɪə(r)§n. 边境，边界；开发地区的边缘地带；[常pl.] 前沿，新领域§The police are closely spread over the frontier between the land of China and that of Nepal.§警力密布于中国与尼泊尔的边境上。
22764§fascinating§ˈfæsɪneɪtɪŋ§adj. 迷人的§The museum has a fascinating collection of Celtic artifacts.§该博物馆藏有吸引人的凯尔特手工艺品。
22765§stroke§strəʊk§n. 击，打；（病）突然发作，中风；（体育中的）击球；笔触，一笔；（游泳或划船的）划，划法；一击；报时的钟声；抚摸vt. 轻抚，抚摸§People who suffer strokes on the left side of the brain usually lose their power of speech.§左脑中风的人常常会丧失语言能力。
22766§solar§ˈsəʊlə(r)§adj. 太阳的；（利用）太阳能的§Of all the planets in our own solar system, the Earth is the only one on which life can survive.§在太阳系所有行星中，地球是唯一一颗生命可以存活的行星。
22767§sympathise§ˈsɪmpəθaɪz§vi. 同情；赞同§Although he pretended to sympathise, I knew he was laughing up his sleeve.§虽然他装作同情，但我知道他正暗自偷笑。
22768§fusion§ˈfjuːʒn§n. 熔化，熔合；聚变§Singapore culture is a successful fusion of Eastern and Western features.§新加坡文化成功融合了东西方文化的特点。
22769§slash§slæʃ§n. 砍痕，伤痕；斜线号 v. 砍；大幅度削减§Their habits of hunting, fishing, and slash-and-burn cultivation have been often harmful to the habitat.§他们渔猎和刀耕火种的习性通常会破坏其生存环境。
22770§diversity§daɪˈvɜːsəti§n. 多样性；差异§The study of primitive peoples has discovered a great diversity of customs, values, feelings, and thoughts.§对原始人类的研究发现其在风俗习惯、价值观、 情感以及思想上具有丰富的多样性。
22771§decline§dɪˈklaɪn§n./v. 下降，减少；衰退，衰落§Technological advances helped bring about the decline of rural industries and an increase in urban populations.§技术进步加速了乡镇企业的衰落和城市人口的增长。
22772§crisis§ˈkraɪsɪs§n. 危机；紧要关头，关键阶段§In the U.S., energy-efficient homes became popular after the oil crisis.§美国在经历了石油危机之后，节能型房屋就开始变得深受欢迎。
22773§edible§ˈedəbl§adj. 可食用的§The seeds of these plants are edible.§这些植物的种子是可食用的。
22774§collaboration§kəˌlæbəˈreɪʃn§n. 合作，协作；勾结，通敌§Museum staff carried out the anthropological projects in collaboration with a wide variety of national governments.§博物馆工作人员与多国政府合作完成了这些人类学工程。
22775§decouple§diːˈkʌpl§v. （使两事物）分离，隔断§Increased production has been almost entirely decoupled from employment.§增加的产量几乎完全被就业问题抵消了。
22776§participant§pɑːˈtɪsɪpənt§n. 参加者，参与者§Group tours encourage participants to look at new objects and places.§团体旅游鼓励游客多去看新景点。
22777§weaken§ˈwiːkən§v. （使）变弱，（使）减弱§He weakened as the illness grew worse.§他病情加重，身体日益衰弱。
22778§distract§dɪˈstrækt§vt. 转移（注意力）；使分心§Researchers claim that when children come to a word they already know, the pictures are unnecessary and distracting.§研究人员称，当孩子们碰到认识的单词时，配图是多余的，会使他们分心。
22779§frown§fraʊn§vi. （表示愤怒或烦心而）皱眉§Colleges always frown on late nights out.§大学向来不赞成深夜外出。
22780§skew§skjuː§vt. 偏离，歪斜；曲解，歪曲 adj. 歪斜的§She says the U.S. market for goods has been skewed by the assumption.§她说美国商品市场已被这种假设扭曲了。
22781§beehive§ˈbiːhaɪv§n. 蜂窝；蜂箱§A beehive is where bees live.§蜂窝是蜜蜂居住的地方。
22782§astray§əˈstreɪ§adv. 迷路地；误入歧途地§Follow the guide or you'll go astray in the jungle.§跟着导游，否则你们会在丛林里迷路。
22783§theory§ˈθɪəri§n. 理论，原理；学说；意见，看法§Tom once put forward an attractive though unlikely theory.§汤姆曾经提出一个具有吸引力但不太可能的理论。
22784§weakness§ˈwiːknəs§n. 虚弱；缺点；偏好，嗜好§Iridology can help doctors discover any constitutional weakness long before its clinical outbreak.§虹膜学能够帮助医生早在体质虚弱症出现临床症状前就发现它。
22785§portion§ˈpɔːʃn§n. 部分；一份 vt. 划分，分配§The energy system uses the visible portion of the solar spectrum to light buildings.§该能源系统利用太阳光谱中的可见光来为建筑照明。
22786§compound§kəmˈpaʊnd§vt. 使恶化，加重；使化合，使合成[ˈkɒmpaʊnd] n. 化合物，复合物；（有围墙或篱笆等的）楼群，大院 adj. 复合的，化合的；综合的§The problems were compounded by severe food shortages.§严重的食物短缺使问题进一步恶化了。
22787§span§spæn§n. 跨距；一段时间 v. 横跨；持续§The workers completed the building within the span of three months.§工人们在三个月的时间内建成了这栋大楼。
22788§vacancy§ˈveɪkənsi§n. （酒店等的）空房间；（职位的）空缺，空职§We have vacancies for salesmen.§我们销售人员的职位有空缺。
22789§locality§ləʊˈkæləti§n. 位置；地区§A species may have more chances to survive if the individuals do not gather in a single locality.§如果某一物种的个体不集中在某单独地区，那么该物种就有了更多的生存机会。
22790§circle§ˈsɜːkl§n. 圆圈，环状物；圈子，阶层；周期，循环 v. 圈出；盘旋，环绕…移动§What you are doing will start up a vicious circle.§你的所作所为会引起恶性循环。
22791§accuracy§ˈækjərəsi§n. 准确（性），精确（性）§The technician placed the machine in the correct spot with complete accuracy.§技术员分毫不差地将机器安放在正确的位置。
22792§tolerate§ˈtɒləreɪt§vt. 容忍，宽容；容许，承认§Younger people tend to tolerate noise better than their elders.§年轻人比年长者更能承受噪音。
22793§afford§əˈfɔːd§v. 负担得起；买得起§They would not be able to afford cars or homes.§他们买不起汽车和房子。
22794§excellent§ˈeksələnt§adj. 极好的；杰出的§Under several metres of earth, noise is minimal and insulation is excellent.§在地下几米的地方，噪音很小，隔热效果也很好。
22795§connect§kəˈnekt§v. 连接，衔接；联合，关联；由…联想到；给…接通电话§What special food and activities are connected with this festival?§有什么特别的食物和活动与这个节日相关？
22796§cylinder§ˈsɪlɪndə(r)§n. 圆柱体；圆筒；汽缸§The earliest British rocket was encased in a stout, iron cylinder, terminating in a conical head.§英国最老式的火箭装在一个坚固的铁筒内，顶部成圆锥形。
22797§disadvantage§ˌdɪsədˈvɑːntɪdʒ§n. 缺点，不利§What are the advantages and disadvantages of making films of real-life events?§根据真实事件拍摄的电影，其优势和劣势分别是什么呢？
22798§participate§pɑːˈtɪsɪpeɪt§vi. 参加，参与§More and more women are participating in politics.§越来越多的女性投身政治。
22799§principle§ˈprɪnsəpl§n. 原则，原理；规范，准则；基本信念，信条§How does the reaction principle work?§反作用原理是如何起作用的呢？
22800§refreshment§rɪˈfreʃmənt§n. （精力的）恢复；[pl.] 茶点，饮料§You can use the members' lounge for refreshment when you feel tired.§你感到疲倦时可以在会员休息室休息一下。
22801§deteriorate§dɪˈtɪəriəreɪt§v. 变坏，恶化；退化§Air quality in many of the world's major cities has deteriorated.§世界上很多大城市的空气质量越来越糟糕。
22802§scorching§ˈskɔːtʃɪŋ§adj. 酷热的；激烈的§The scorching summer left people enervated and listless.§炎热的夏天让人虚弱无力，情绪低落。
22803§meantime§ˈmiːntaɪm§n. 在…期间；眼下，暂时 adv. 同时，当时§The country was urgently calling for peace while in the meantime secretly doing nuclear tests.§该国急切呼吁和平，同时却又秘密进行核试验。
22804§upper§ˈʌpə(r)§adj. 上面的；地位较高的§Helen lived on the upper floor.§海伦住在楼上。
22805§innocent§ˈɪnəsnt§adj. 天真的；清白的；无害的§Seeing these innocent children, I can't help recalling my own childhood.§看到这些天真无邪的孩子，我不禁想起了自己的童年。
22806§emphasis§ˈemfəsɪs§n. 强调；重要性§The President's statement gave emphasis to the crisis.§总统在声明中强调了这次危机。
22807§approach§əˈprəʊtʃ§v. 靠近，接近；来临 n. 靠近，接近；方法，途径§As autumn approaches, the beekeepers pack up their hives and go south.§秋天来临，养蜂人收好蜂房前往南方。
22808§duration§djuˈreɪʃn§n. 持续；持续的时间；期间§The school was used as a hospital for the duration of the war.§整个战争期间这所学校都被用作医院。
22809§primarily§praɪˈmerəli§adv. 首先；主要地，首要地§In refineries, caustic is primarily used to remove sulfur compounds.§在精炼厂，腐蚀剂主要用于去除硫化物。

22810§due§djuː§adj. 到期的，预期的；应有的，应得的；正当的；适当的；合适的§The greenhouse effect is a natural phenomenon involving the increase in global surface temperature due to the presence of greenhouse gases.§温室效应是一种自然现象，指由于温室气体的出现而导致地球表面温度升高。
